mapper.sql: CHID, CUID, ChapterName, Summary, VideoUrl, Orders, Status, CreateTime, Remark
mapper.select: SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapter_files f WHERE f.CHID = chapters.CHID) AS fileCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapter_quizzes q WHERE q.CHID = chapters.CHID) AS quizCount FROM chapters WHERE CUID = #{cuid} AND Status = 1 ORDER BY Orders, CHID
SELECT FROM chapters WHERE CUID = #{cuid} ORDER BY Orders, CHID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chapters (CUID, ChapterName, Summary, VideoUrl, Orders, Status, Remark) VALUES (#{cuid}, #{chapterName}, #{summary}, #{videoUrl}, #{orders}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE chapters SET Status = 0 WHERE CHID = #{chid}
UPDATE chapters SET Status = 0 WHERE CUID = #{cuid}
mapper.select: SELECT ch.CHID, ch.CUID, ch.ChapterName, ch.Summary, ch.VideoUrl, ch.Orders, ch.Status, ch.CreateTime, ch.Remark, c.CourseName AS courseName FROM chapters ch INNER JOIN courses c ON ch.CUID = c.CUID WHERE ch.Status = 0 ORDER BY ch.CreateTime DESC, ch.CHID DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chapters SET Status = 1 WHERE CHID = #{chid}
mapper.select: SELECT CHID FROM chapters WHERE CUID = #{cuid}
